prompt:
Create a new KFB ink blob monster character sheet, The Wrong Century Excursion. Supplied original PNGs are style inputs for rounded ink anatomy, thick modeled lids, plasticine surface and handcrafted accessory scale. Create exactly SIX full individual upright actors in a 3-column by 2-row landscape 1536×1024 PNG with a true transparent alpha backdrop. Each actor at equal substantial scale inside their own logical cell, entire prop and all droplets inside generous transparent gutters and outer margin. No scenery, floor, labels, border, branding, joined figures or background color. Each is a dark charcoal continuous footless ink splat with subtle plum sheen and rich softly rounded clay, small goo hands, bare goo base and expressive asymmetrical organic lobes. Compact costume pieces wrap the blob. Thick filled dark lids with white sclera, red iris and black pupil. Teeth inside lips. Offbeat tourist satire, six different poses, looks and mouth shapes. Visible wear and miniature handcrafted volume. No copied eyepatches, wings, military insignia or outfits from references. Wardrobe family: retro future holiday kits, tourist florals, teal plastic travel gadgets and paper tags. Row-major cast:
1. Female-read unimpressed time tour guide: square upright splat, one raised lid, compressed frown. Prop: chunky clock-faced paddle and rolled itinerary.
2. Male-read delighted paradox photographer: round curved ink blob, delighted side gaze, crooked open laugh. Prop: chunky instant camera with one miniature print coming out.
3. Male-read drowsy era-hopper: low wide blob, heavy lids, tiny sleepy grin. Prop: oversized hourglass neck pillow and stamped passport.
4. Female-read offended off-world bargain guest: tall pear, pointed side-eye, pursed pout. Prop: miniature crater souvenir in a clear globe.
5. Male-read panicking lost luggage traveller: lopsided bean, round startled eyes, tiny open oval. Prop: small scuffed suitcase with wildly mismatched clock tags.
6. Male-read fascinated destruction tourist: lean wide-based blob, eyes sideways, narrow surprised smile. Prop: fat toy binoculars and rolled viewing map.
Emphasize eyes and acting. Keep every figure independently usable as a sightseeing bystander. Hold props close. Separate all six in clear alpha.
